notes: A with value interpolates a node no document declares. The schema treats with as an open object and reference resolution is a runner check, so the expected keyword is the runner rule name rather than an AJV keyword. The located error is nodes.verify.with.artifact; error_path stays at /nodes so the assertion holds whichever depth the lint reports. The graph carries no cycle and no gate node on purpose: the DAG lint and the gate-continue lint run ahead of every other lint for a definition, and only the first error is read.
